hints: Reread the first point of the lesson: "A feature-and-date roadmap ('Ship X by Q3') optimizes for shipping things, not for whether those things actually work — an outcome-based roadmap organizes around goals ('reduce onboarding drop-off by 20%') with features as hypotheses to test"
